name: Kaaterskill Falls
where: Kaaterskill Wild Forest, Catskill Park · Laurel House Road, Haines Falls, New York
blurb: A two-tier, 260-foot waterfall at the head of Kaaterskill Clove: the viewing platform, the stone staircase to the pools, and the Escarpment Trail to Inspiration Point.

trails.name: Kaaterskill Falls Trail to the pools
Escarpment Trail loop to Inspiration Point

status: Open. The Molly Smith lot on Route 23A is closed and Route 23A pull-off parking is banned May–October; park at Laurel House Road, Schutt Road or North–South Lake. Kaaterskill Clove is closed from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise.
